user.title: Set up VCVideo NVR
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to your VCVideo NVR to expose all camera channels as entities.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure VCVideo NVR
reconfigure.description: Update the connection details of your VCVideo NVR.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with the NVR
reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for {host} are no longer accepted. Please enter them again.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the NVR. Check the IP address and port.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials. Check username and password.

abort.wrong_device: The entered address belongs to a different NVR.

init.title: VCVideo NVR options
init.description: Control how camera thumbnails (still images) are produced.

data_description.snapshot_source: Most NVRs of this family offer no still-image endpoint, so thumbnails are grabbed from the RTSP stream. Leave this on automatic unless the thumbnails stay empty.
data_description.ffmpeg_arguments: Input options passed to FFmpeg when grabbing a frame, for example -rtsp_transport tcp. Clear this field to let FFmpeg pick the transport.
